note: 产生误解 / 有误解 = a misunderstanding arises / exists.

examples.zh: 对不起，这是我的误解。
examples.en: Sorry, that was my misunderstanding.

examples.zh: 你别误解，我不是那个意思。
examples.en: Don't misunderstand; that's not what I meant.

examples.zh: 说清楚一点，就不会有误解了。
examples.en: If you explain it more clearly, there won't be any misunderstanding.

meaning: all at once, suddenly; in an instant

senses.en: all at once, suddenly; in an instant

examples.zh: 门一下子就关上了。
examples.en: The door suddenly shut.

examples.zh: 东西太多，我一下子学不完。
examples.en: There's too much; I can't learn it all at once.

examples.zh: 他一下子站了起来，走出去了。
examples.en: He stood up all of a sudden and walked out.

meaning: cun, a unit of length (about 3.3 cm); inch

senses.en: cun, a unit of length (about 3.3 cm); inch

note: Also in 一寸 光阴 and 尺寸 (size); 照片 sizes are often given in 寸.

examples.zh: 我想洗一张六寸的照片。
examples.en: I'd like to print a six-inch photo.

examples.zh: 这块布只有一寸宽。
examples.en: This piece of cloth is only one cun wide.

examples.zh: 这台电视有五十五寸。
examples.en: This TV is fifty-five inches.

note: 慌 = panic; 得慌 follows an adjective/verb for unpleasant extremes: 累得慌, 闷得慌.

examples.zh: 别慌，慢慢说，怎么了？
examples.en: Don't panic. Tell me slowly, what happened?

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她心里有点儿慌。
examples.en: Hearing the news, she felt a bit panicky.

examples.zh: 今天走了一天，我累得慌。
examples.en: I walked all day today and I'm terribly tired.

examples.zh: 这条规定没有例外。
examples.en: This rule has no exceptions.

examples.zh: 大家都要来，你也不能例外。
examples.en: Everyone has to come, and you can't be an exception.

examples.zh: 这次是例外，下次不行。
examples.en: This time is an exception; next time it won't work.

note: Fairly formal; used for 保卫 国家, 保卫 家园.

examples.zh: 他们为了保卫家乡而努力。
examples.en: They worked hard to defend their hometown.

examples.zh: 士兵的工作是保卫国家。
examples.en: A soldier's job is to defend the country.

examples.zh: 我们要保卫自己的权利。
examples.en: We must safeguard our own rights.

meaning: to pack up; to get leftovers or takeout packed

senses.en: to pack up; to get leftovers or takeout packed

examples.zh: 菜太多了，请帮我打包。
examples.en: There's too much food; please pack it up for me.

examples.zh: 服务员，这个汤能打包吗？
examples.en: Waiter, can I take this soup to go?

examples.zh: 你们的行李打包好了没有？
examples.en: Have you finished packing your luggage?

examples.zh: 我们订了一家便宜的宾馆。
examples.en: We booked a cheap hotel.

examples.zh: 这家宾馆离机场远不远？
examples.en: Is this hotel far from the airport?

examples.zh: 请问，宾馆里有早饭吗？
examples.en: Excuse me, does the hotel serve breakfast?

note: Also names the 1949 victory: 解放 前 = before Liberation. Also 解放 双手 = free one's hands.

examples.zh: 机器能解放我们的双手。
examples.en: Machines can free up our hands.

examples.zh: 我爷爷是解放前出生的。
examples.en: My grandfather was born before Liberation.

examples.zh: 工作做完了，终于解放了！
examples.en: The work is done; I'm finally free!

examples.zh: 他们在客厅里看电视。
examples.en: They are watching TV in the living room.

examples.zh: 我家的客厅不大，但是很亮。
examples.en: The living room in my home isn't big, but it is bright.

examples.zh: 请把行李放在客厅吧。
examples.en: Please put the luggage in the living room.

examples.zh: 小心，别把水洒在地上。
examples.en: Careful, don't spill water on the floor.

examples.zh: 汤洒了，快拿点纸来。
examples.en: The soup spilled; quick, get some paper.

examples.zh: 出门前，他在花上洒了点水。
examples.en: Before going out, he sprinkled a little water on the flowers.

meaning: to fall down, slip and fall

senses.en: to fall down, slip and fall

examples.zh: 地很滑，我差点儿摔倒。
examples.en: The ground is slippery and I almost fell.

examples.zh: 孩子在公园里摔倒了，哭了。
examples.en: The child fell down in the park and cried.

examples.zh: 老人摔倒了，我们快去帮他。
examples.en: The old man has fallen; let's help him quickly.

note: Used for sleep quality and habits: 睡眠 不足, 睡眠 质量. In speech: 睡觉.

examples.zh: 最近我的睡眠不太好。
examples.en: My sleep hasn't been very good lately.

examples.zh: 医生说我睡眠不够。
examples.en: The doctor said I'm not getting enough sleep.

examples.zh: 好的睡眠对身体很重要。
examples.en: Good sleep is very important for your health.

meaning: to compensate (for damage or loss); compensation

senses.en: to compensate (for damage or loss); compensation

note: More formal than 赔; used for damage or loss, e.g. 要求赔偿.

examples.zh: 你打坏了我的手机，要赔偿。
examples.en: You broke my phone, so you must compensate me.

examples.zh: 公司同意赔偿我们的损失。
examples.en: The company agreed to compensate us for our loss.

examples.zh: 他要求对方赔偿，但是没成功。
examples.en: He asked the other side for compensation, but it didn't work.

examples.zh: 当医生是一件光荣的事。
examples.en: Being a doctor is an honorable thing.

examples.zh: 他为自己的工作感到光荣。
examples.en: He feels proud of his work.

examples.zh: 这是学校的光荣。
examples.en: This is an honor for the school.

examples.zh: 你的话没有逻辑，我听不懂。
examples.en: What you say has no logic; I can't follow it.

examples.zh: 这篇文章的逻辑很清楚。
examples.en: The logic of this article is very clear.

examples.zh: 他做事很有逻辑。
examples.en: He does things in a very logical way.

meaning: actually, on the contrary (mild contrast or concession)

senses.en: actually, on the contrary (mild contrast or concession)

note: Softens a contrast: 想法 倒是 不错 , 就是 ... (the idea is fine, but...).

examples.zh: 这个办法倒是不错，就是太贵了。
examples.en: This method is actually not bad; it's just too expensive.

examples.zh: 他说得倒是容易，做起来很难。
examples.en: It's easy for him to say, but hard to do.

examples.zh: 你倒是快点儿说呀！
examples.en: Say it already, will you!

note: Derogatory; also used jokingly among close friends.

examples.zh: 他爸爸是个酒鬼，一喝就醉。
examples.en: His father is a drunkard who gets drunk as soon as he drinks.

examples.zh: 别跟那些酒鬼一起喝酒。
examples.en: Don't drink with those drunkards.

examples.zh: 你喝这么多，真成了酒鬼。
examples.en: You drink so much; you've really become a drunk.

meaning: to regard, view, treat (a matter or person)

senses.en: to regard, view, treat (a matter or person)

note: 如何 看待 / 怎么 看待 + issue.

examples.zh: 你怎么看待这件事？
examples.en: How do you see this matter?

examples.zh: 我们应该公平地看待每个人。
examples.en: We should treat everyone fairly.

examples.zh: 老人看待钱的方式和年轻人不同。
examples.en: Older people view money differently from young people.

examples.zh: 房子四周都是树。
examples.en: There are trees all around the house.

examples.zh: 他看了看四周，没有人。
examples.en: He looked around; there was nobody.

examples.zh: 四周很安静，只有风的声音。
examples.en: It's quiet all around, with only the sound of the wind.
